headline: Instincts are your body's warning system—evolved responses that alert you to potential danger
universal_truth: Your body knows things your mind hasn't noticed; intuition is data processed below consciousness
fun_facts: Your gut has over 100 million neurons—it literally 'thinks' and sends signals to your brain
Intuitive unease often registers before conscious awareness—your body notices danger first
Animals reliably detect threats through instinct that humans often rationalize away
discussion_questions: When has your gut been right when your mind was wrong?
How do you distinguish intuition from anxiety?
When should you trust your alarm system versus override it?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Something feels wrong. You can't explain it, but you feel uneasy. That's your alarm system—millions of years of evolution detecting patterns your conscious mind hasn't noticed. Your body is processing danger signals below awareness.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We're taught to trust reason over feeling. But intuition carries information too. What's the relationship between instinct and conscious thought?

options.text: Intuition is pattern recognition below consciousness—your brain processes vast amounts of data and sends conclusions as feelings before they become thoughts
options.response: Yes. Intuition isn't magic—it's unconscious processing. Your brain notices patterns you haven't consciously seen and alerts you through feeling. It's data in emotional form.
It feels like emotion, but it often contains information—processed perception below awareness...

q1.title: Unconscious Processing
q1.script: Your brain processes millions of signals you never consciously notice. When patterns suggest danger, you feel uneasy before knowing why. The alarm fires before the analysis completes.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Unconscious Processing"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: When to Trust
q2.script: Trust instinct in its domain: detecting social threats, sensing environmental danger, recognizing patterns in familiar territory. Be more skeptical when instinct encounters unfamiliar situations.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Don't Rationalize Away
q3.script: When something feels wrong, don't immediately rationalize it away. Investigate. Your alarm might be right. Many who ignored intuition regretted it—many who heeded it didn't.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: Your body knows things your mind hasn't noticed. Intuition is data processed below consciousness. Heed your alarm system.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 317. Tomorrow, we'll explore worry about what hasn't happened—anxiety. Until then, notice when your alarm system activates.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Intuition Log - What Is Your Body Telling You?
growTrack.activity: Recall times your intuition was right. What did it feel like? Now notice current intuitive signals. What feels 'off' that you can't explain? Don't dismiss it—investigate it.
